listen_addr.description: IP address the web server will bind to.

listen_port.description: Port the web server will listen on.

entropy_source_path.description: Filesystem path to the hardware entropy source device.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of simultaneous incoming requests the server will handle.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS enabled).

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn.

rate_limit_rps.description: Maximum requests per second per client (when rate limiting enabled).

cors_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS requests. Each entry is a URL or '*' for all.

items.description: A single allowed CORS origin (e.g., 'https://example.com' or '*').

health_endpoint_path.description: HTTP path for the health check endpoint.

metrics_endpoint_path.description: HTTP path for the Prometheus-style metrics endpoint.

timeout_connect.description: Timeout (seconds) for connecting to the entropy source.

timeout_read.description: Timeout (seconds) for reading entropy from the source.

timeout_write.description: Timeout (seconds) for writing response to client.

cache_enabled.description: Enable caching of entropy responses (e.g., for low-entropy sources).

cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries in the entropy cache.
